1: <?php
2: 
3: namespace SkyVerge\WooCommerce\Facebook\Feed;
4: 
5: use Error;
6: 
7: defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;
8: 
9: /**
10:  * A class responsible for managing and interacting with the actual feed file.
11:  * Creating, writing, deleting, renaming temporary to destination, setting up folder protection.
12:  *
13:  * @since 2.6.0
14:  */
15: class FeedFileHandler {
16: 
17: 	const OPTION_FEED_URL_SECRET = 'wc_facebook_feed_url_secret';
18: 	const REQUEST_FEED_ACTION    = 'facebook_for_woocommerce_get_feed';
19: 
20: 	/**
21: 	 * Filename to export to.
22: 	 *
23: 	 * @var string
24: 	 */
25: 	public $filename = 'product_catalog_%s.csv';
26: 
27: 	/**
28: 	 * Temporary export file.
29: 	 *
30: 	 * @var string
31: 	 */
32: 	public $temp_filename = 'temp_product_catalog_%s.csv';
33: 
34: 	/**
35: 	 * Location of feed CSV files.
36: 	 *
37: 	 * @since 2.6.0
38: 	 */
39: 	public function get_feed_directory() {
40: 		$upload_dir = wp_upload_dir();
41: 		return trailingslashit( $upload_dir['basedir'] ) . 'facebook_for_woocommerce/';
42: 	}
43: 
44: 	/**
45: 	 * Return the CSV feed filename.
46: 	 *
47: 	 * @since 2.6.0
48: 	 * @return string
49: 	 */
50: 	public function get_filename() {
51: 		return sanitize_file_name(
52: 			sprintf(
53: 				$this->filename,
54: 				self::get_feed_secret()
55: 			)
56: 		);
57: 	}
58: 
59: 	/**
60: 	 * Return a filename.
61: 	 *
62: 	 * @since 2.6.0
63: 	 * @return string
64: 	 */
65: 	public function get_temp_filename() {
66: 		return sanitize_file_name(
67: 			sprintf(
68: 				$this->temp_filename,
69: 				self::get_feed_secret()
70: 			)
71: 		);
72: 	}
73: 
74: 	/**
75: 	 * Get file path to export to.
76: 	 *
77: 	 * @since 2.6.0
78: 	 * @return string
79: 	 */
80: 	public function get_file_path() {
81: 		return $this->get_feed_directory() . $this->get_filename();
82: 	}
83: 
84: 	/**
85: 	 * Get file path to export to.
86: 	 *
87: 	 * @since 2.6.0
88: 	 * @return string
89: 	 */
90: 	public function get_temporary_file_path() {
91: 		return $this->get_feed_directory() . $this->get_temp_filename();
92: 	}
93: 
94: 	/**
95: 	 * Setup feed location folder.
96: 	 * Prevent unauthorized access.
97: 	 *
98: 	 * @since 2.6.0
99: 	 * @throws Error Folder creation not possible.
100: 	 */
101: 	public function prepare_feed_folder() {
102: 		$catalog_feed_directory = trailingslashit( $this->get_feed_directory() );
103: 
104: 		if ( ! wp_mkdir_p( $catalog_feed_directory ) ) {
105: 			throw new Error( __( 'Could not create product catalog feed directory', 'facebook-for-woocommerce' ), 500 );
106: 		}
107: 
108: 		$files = array(
109: 			array(
110: 				'base'    => $catalog_feed_directory,
111: 				'file'    => 'index.html',
112: 				'content' => '',
113: 			),
114: 			array(
115: 				'base'    => $catalog_feed_directory,
116: 				'file'    => '.htaccess',
117: 				'content' => 'deny from all',
118: 			),
119: 		);
120: 
121: 		foreach ( $files as $file ) {
122: 			if ( wp_mkdir_p( $file['base'] ) && ! file_exists( trailingslashit( $file['base'] ) . $file['file'] ) ) {
123: 				$file_handle = fopen( trailingslashit( $file['base'] ) . $file['file'], 'w' ); // phpcs::ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_system_read_fopen, Generic.PHP.NoSilencedErrors.Discouraged
124: 				if ( $file_handle ) {
125: 					fwrite( $file_handle, $file['content'] ); // phpcs::ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_system_read_fwrite, Generic.PHP.NoSilencedErrors.Discouraged
126: 					fclose( $file_handle ); // phpcs::ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_system_read_fclose, Generic.PHP.NoSilencedErrors.Discouraged
127: 				}
128: 			}
129: 		}
130: 	}
131: 
132: 	/**
133: 	 * Setup empty CSV file for temporary output.
134: 	 * Remove old file, create a new one, set appropriate permissions.
135: 	 *
136: 	 * @since 2.6.0
137: 	 */
138: 	public function create_fresh_feed_temporary_file() {
139: 		if ( file_exists( ( $this->get_temporary_file_path() ) ) ) {
140: 			unlink( $this->get_temporary_file_path() );
141: 		}
142: 		file_put_contents( $this->get_temporary_file_path(), '' ); // phpcs::ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_system_read_file_put_contents, Generic.PHP.NoSilencedErrors.Discouraged
143: 		chmod( $this->get_temporary_file_path(), 0664 );
144: 	}
145: 
146: 	/**
147: 	 * Write data to temporary CSV file.
148: 	 *
149: 	 * @since 2.6.0
150: 	 * @param string $data Data to write to the file.
151: 	 */
152: 	public function write_to_feed_temporary_file( $data ) {
153: 		file_put_contents( $this->get_temporary_file_path(), $data, FILE_APPEND ); // phpcs::ignore WordPress.WP.AlternativeFunctions.file_system_read_file_put_contents, Generic.PHP.NoSilencedErrors.Discouraged
154: 	}
155: 
156: 	/**
157: 	 * Last step of the feed generation procedure.
158: 	 * We have been writing to the temporary file until now.
159: 	 * We can safely delate old feed file and replace it with
160: 	 * the content of temporary file.
161: 	 *
162: 	 * @since 2.6.0
163: 	 */
164: 	public function replace_feed_file_with_temp_file() {
165: 		rename( // phpcs:ignore WordPress.VIP.FileSystemWritesDisallow.file_ops_rename, Generic.PHP.NoSilencedErrors.Discouraged,
166: 			$this->get_temporary_file_path(),
167: 			$this->get_file_path()
168: 		);
169: 	}
170: 
171: 	/**
172: 	 * Gets the secret value that should be included in the Feed URL.
173: 	 *
174: 	 * Generates a new secret and stores it in the database if no value is set.
175: 	 *
176: 	 * @since 1.11.0
177: 	 * @since 2.6.0 moved from Feed class( now deleted )
178: 	 * @return string
179: 	 */
180: 	public static function get_feed_secret() {
181: 
182: 		$secret = get_option( self::OPTION_FEED_URL_SECRET, '' );
183: 
184: 		if ( ! $secret ) {
185: 
186: 			$secret = wp_hash( 'products-feed-' . time() );
187: 
188: 			update_option( self::OPTION_FEED_URL_SECRET, $secret );
189: 		}
190: 
191: 		return $secret;
192: 	}
193: 
194: 	/**
195: 	 * Gets the URL for retrieving the product feed data.
196: 	 *
197: 	 * @since 1.11.0
198: 	 * @since 2.6.0 moved from Feed class( now deleted )
199: 	 * @return string
200: 	 */
201: 	public static function get_feed_data_url() {
202: 
203: 		$query_args = array(
204: 			'wc-api' => self::REQUEST_FEED_ACTION,
205: 			'secret' => self::get_feed_secret(),
206: 		);
207: 
208: 		return add_query_arg( $query_args, home_url( '/' ) );
209: 	}
210: }
